description: This source file implements the MediaMetricsProvider class, which collects and reports media playback metrics, including pipeline status, codecs, encryption, and other playback-related data. It manages interactions with UKM and UMA metrics, and provides methods to initialize metrics, record errors, fallback events, and acquire various recorders.

classes.name: MediaMetricsProvider
classes.description: A class that collects media playback metrics, manages reporting to UKM and UMA, and provides interfaces to record various media events and states.

classes.name: MediaMetricsProvider::PipelineInfo
classes.description: A struct holding information about a media pipeline, such as whether it is incognito and codec details.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::Create
methods.description: Creates and binds a new MediaMetricsProvider instance to a Mojo receiver.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetHasPlayed
methods.description: Marks that the media has been played at least once.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetHasAudio
methods.description: Records that the media has audio with the specified codec.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetHasVideo
methods.description: Records that the media has video with the specified codec.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetHaveEnough
methods.description: Indicates that the media has reached a state where enough data has been loaded.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetVideoPipelineInfo
methods.description: Sets information about the video pipeline, including decoder type and platform details.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetAudioPipelineInfo
methods.description: Sets information about the audio pipeline.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes media info with MSE, URL scheme, and media stream type.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::OnError
methods.description: Records a pipeline error status.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::OnFallback
methods.description: Handles fallback events during media playback.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetIsEME
methods.description: Marks the media as encrypted media extension (EME).

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetTimeToMetadata
methods.description: Records the time to metadata availability.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetTimeToFirstFrame
methods.description: Records the time to first video frame.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetTimeToPlayReady
methods.description: Records the time until the media is ready to play.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetContainerName
methods.description: Sets the media container name.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetRendererType
methods.description: Sets the renderer type used for media playback.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetKeySystem
methods.description: Sets the key system used for encrypted media.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::SetIsHardwareSecure
methods.description: Marks the media as hardware secure.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::AcquireWatchTimeRecorder
methods.description: Creates and binds a WatchTimeRecorder for tracking playback time.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::AcquireVideoDecodeStatsRecorder
methods.description: Creates and binds a VideoDecodeStatsRecorder.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::AcquirePlaybackEventsRecorder
methods.description: Creates and binds a PlaybackEventsRecorder if enabled.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::AcquireLearningTaskController
methods.description: Creates and binds a learning task controller for adaptive learning features.

methods.name: MediaMetricsProvider::IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the media info has been initialized.
